# Cloudflare service catalog for flare-operator

As of **2026-09-29**. This document lists every Cloudflare product that can be provisioned, and for each one gives:

- its status
- its API surface
- the closest Kubernetes primitive
- the operator tier it falls into
- the pitfalls that matter for a reconciler

**Companion file:** [`cloudflare-api-coverage.md`](cloudflare-api-coverage.md). It is generated by `hack/classify_api.py` and classifies **all 3,620 operations in 231 API path groups** of the official OpenAPI spec. The script fails if the spec gains a group nobody has classified, so re-running it after spec updates shows what's new.

**Sources:**

- [`cloudflare/api-schemas` openapi.json](https://github.com/cloudflare/api-schemas): 2,273 paths
- the [developers.cloudflare.com/llms.txt](https://developers.cloudflare.com/llms.txt) product index: every listed product is covered below
- [terraform-provider-cloudflare](https://github.com/cloudflare/terraform-provider-cloudflare) v5.26.0 (2026-09-26)
- product docs and changelogs (full list at the end)

"(unverified)" marks claims backed by only one secondary source.

---

## 0. Tiers

| Tier | Meaning | Share of API ops |
|---|---|---|
| **T1** | Hand-written core CRD with rich semantics (refs, bindings, rollouts) | 15% |
| **T2** | Declarative, but long-tail. CRDs are generated from OpenAPI with Forge, or a generic `CloudflareResource` is used | 44% |
| **T3** | Imperative or one-shot (jobs, purges, purchases, L3/BGP changes). Handled by a Job-style CRD, or by an opt-in with an explicit guard | 10% |
| **RO** | Read-only: analytics, intel, findings. Surfaced in `status` or metrics, or ignored | 22% |
| **X** | Out of scope: billing, org/tenant admin, deprecated, internal | 6% |

## 1. Auth and API constraints

| Topic | Decision |
|---|---|
| Credential | An **account-owned API token** (`/accounts/{id}/tokens`, `cfat_` prefix). It is a service principal not tied to a person, and resource-scoped permissions are now GA. Use a **user token** only for endpoints that don't accept account tokens, such as Origin CA `/certificates` (unverified). |
| Not allowed | Global API Key (legacy; `cf` has disabled it). Service Key (end of life **2026-09-30**). OAuth clients (authorization-code only, with no client-credentials grant, so a headless controller can't use them). |
| Minting | The operator can create narrower per-namespace or per-tenant tokens through `/accounts/{id}/tokens`. The limit is 500 account tokens per account. Refer to permission groups by **ID**. New tokens are scannable and auto-revoked if leaked. |
| Rate limits | **1,200 requests per 5 minutes per token** (about 4 per second); exceeding it blocks the token for 5 minutes. Also 200 requests per second per IP. Cache Purge, Rulesets, Lists and Gateway Lists have their own limits. GraphQL is cost-based. So the operator needs a shared token-bucket rate limiter per token, list-and-cache resyncs instead of polling each object, `/batch` endpoints (DNS, Workflows, infrastructure targets), and it must honour `Retry-After` / `Ratelimit`. |
| Client | Go, using `cloudflare-go`, which is generated from the same OpenAPI spec, behind an internal interface. Cloudflare says Forge will generate its SDKs going forward. |
| `cf` CLI | `cf@1.0.0-beta.5` reads `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN` (otherwise OAuth device flow) and `CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID`. It has no `--api-token` flag. Use it in CI for `cf build` / container image push, not in the reconciler. Its generated commands correspond one-to-one to the OpenAPI spec, so matching the spec means matching `cf`'s coverage. |
| Ownership | Tag every managed resource through **Resource Tagging** (`/accounts/{id}/tags`, public beta), e.g. `flare.dev/owner=<cluster>/<ns>/<name>`. PUT replaces all tags, so do GET, merge, PUT. Also keep the Cloudflare ID in `status` and in an annotation. |

---

## 2. Kubernetes primitive → Cloudflare (revised)

The biggest change since the first design sketch: the Containers API now has a **scheduler-backed mode** (`scheduling_policy: "default"`). Cloudflare keeps `instances` running, with `max_instances`, `constraints.regions` / `jurisdiction`, and **rollouts** (`rolling` or `new_instances`, with step percentages). That is a real Deployment analogue that doesn't need a Durable Object. The DO-managed mode (`scheduling_policy: "durable_object"`) is the StatefulSet analogue.

| Kubernetes | Cloudflare | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Pod (ephemeral, per-request) | Worker isolate, Dynamic Worker (`worker_loader`), Sandbox | Nothing to reconcile for Dynamic Workers and Sandboxes. They are runtime-created. |
| Deployment (JS/Wasm) | Worker script, versions and deployments | A deployment splits traffic across at most 2 versions, which gives canaries. Versions are immutable, and rollback means creating a new deployment. |
| Deployment (OCI image) | **Container app, `scheduling_policy: default`** | `replicas` → `instances`; `strategy` → rollout `rolling` / `new_instances` with `step_percentage`. The config has image, command, entrypoint, env and instance_type. It has **no ports, probes or secret refs**. linux/amd64 only. No GPUs (GPUs are only available through Workers AI). |
| StatefulSet | Container app, `scheduling_policy: durable_object`, plus a DO class | Stable identity comes from the DO ID (`idFromName`). DO SQLite storage persists. No rollouts or versions in this mode. |
| ReplicaSet | Worker version / Container application version | Immutable. |
| Job | Workflow instance, Super Slurper job, Browser Run crawl, D1 import/export | |
| CronJob | Worker cron triggers (`schedules`, PUT replaces the list), Workflow schedules | |
| DaemonSet | none | Every Cloudflare location already acts as a "node". |
| HPA | `max_instances`; Workers autoscale | |
| PodDisruptionBudget | `rollout_active_grace_period` | Loose match. |
| nodeSelector / affinity | `constraints.regions` / `jurisdiction` (eu, us, fedramp); Workers Smart Placement (`placement`) | |
| imagePullSecret | `/containers/registries` + `/credentials` | Allowed registries: registry.cloudflare.com, Docker Hub, ECR, Google Artifact Registry. |
| Service ClusterIP | Service binding (Worker-to-Worker RPC) | No IP. Only bound callers can reach it. |
| Service ExternalName (to a private backend) | **Workers VPC connectivity service** (`tunnel_id` + host + port), or Hyperdrive for Postgres/MySQL | Beta. It can point **back into the cluster** through a Tunnel. |
| Service LoadBalancer (L7) | Load Balancer + pools + monitors | Order: monitor, then pool, then LB. Pools and monitors are account-scoped; LBs are zone-scoped. |
| Service LoadBalancer (L4) / TCPRoute | Spectrum app | |
| GatewayClass | `cloudflare-tunnel` (origins in the cluster) and `cloudflare-workers` (origins on Cloudflare) | |
| Gateway / listener | Zone + hostname + edge cert / Custom Hostname (SaaS) | TLS is automatic. Custom Hostnames are async (DCV). |
| HTTPRoute (tunnel class) | `cfd_tunnel/{id}/configurations` ingress rules + DNS CNAME | The ingress list is replaced as a whole, so one Tunnel CR owns it. |
| HTTPRoute (workers class) | Worker route (zone) / Worker custom domain (account) | Routes match only host and path prefix. For header or weight matching, generate a router Worker or use a Load Balancer. |
| HTTPRoute filters | Rulesets phases: redirect, URL rewrite, request/response header transform, origin, cache | One entrypoint ruleset per phase. The operator either owns the whole phase or manages individual rules by ID. |
| Ingress | Same as HTTPRoute (tunnel class) | |
| NetworkPolicy (ingress, L7 identity) | Access app + policies | |
| NetworkPolicy (egress) | Gateway network/HTTP policies | |
| NetworkPolicy (L3/4) | Network Firewall (`magic_transit` ruleset phase) | Enterprise. |
| ConfigMap | Worker `vars`, KV, Flagship flags | |
| Secret | Worker secrets / Secrets Store | Write-only, so detect drift by comparing hashes. |
| ServiceAccount / token | Access service token (for machine callers); account API token (for the operator itself) | |
| RBAC Role / RoleBinding | IAM permission groups, resource groups, members | |
| PVC / PV | R2 bucket, D1 DB, KV namespace, Artifacts repo, Vectorize index, DO storage | There's no block storage, and container disk is ephemeral. R2 can be mounted with FUSE inside Containers. A `volumeMount` becomes a **binding**. |
| StorageClass | Product + `jurisdiction` + R2 `storage_class` (Standard / Infrequent Access) + location hint | These can't be changed after creation. |
| VolumeSnapshot / restore | D1 Time Travel bookmark / restore (30 days) | |
| Namespace | Workers for Platforms dispatch namespace; tags; a separate account through the Tenant API for hard isolation | |
| Labels | Resource Tagging | |
| Preview environment | Worker Previews (new 2026-09-22) | Each preview gets its own DO and Container namespaces. KV, D1 and R2 are **not** isolated. |
| cert-manager Issuer / Certificate | Origin CA (the existing `cloudflare/origin-ca-issuer`), ACM / custom certificates | |
| ExternalDNS | `dns_records` | ExternalDNS already supports Cloudflare. Interoperate instead of competing: respect its TXT ownership records. |
| Events / logs | Workers observability, Logpush jobs, Notifications | |

## 3. Full product catalog

Path prefixes are relative to `/client/v4`. `A` means `/accounts/{account_id}` and `Z` means `/zones/{zone_id}`. The TF column says whether a Terraform resource exists (as of v5.26.0).

### 3.1 Compute and runtime

| Product | Status | API | TF | K8s analogy | Tier | Operator gotcha |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Workers scripts | GA | `A/workers/scripts/{name}` (content, settings, secrets, schedules, subdomain, tails) | ✓ | Deployment | T1 | Upload is a single multipart PUT that carries metadata and bindings. Secrets are write-only. Limit is 64 MiB uncompressed. |
| Workers "Worker" resource API | GA; previews beta | `A/workers/workers/{id}` (+versions, previews) | ✓ | Deployment | T1 | An ID-based model that coexists with the name-based `/scripts` API. **Pick one** per CRD. |
| Worker versions / deployments | GA | `…/versions`, `…/deployments` | ✓ | ReplicaSet / rollout | T1 | A deployment is immutable and splits across at most 2 versions. |
| Worker Previews | Beta (2026-09-22) | `A/workers/workers/{id}/previews`, `A/builds/workers/{tag}/previews` | – | Preview namespace | T2 | KV, D1 and R2 are shared unless you bind separate ones. |
| Routes / custom domains / workers.dev | GA | `Z/workers/routes`, `A/workers/domains`, `A/workers/subdomain` | ✓ | HTTPRoute | T1 | A custom domain creates DNS and certificates as a side effect. |
| Cron / triggers | GA | `…/scripts/{n}/schedules`, `A/triggers/{script}` | ✓ | CronJob | T1 | PUT replaces the whole list. |
| Static assets | GA | `…/assets-upload-session`, then `A/workers/assets/upload` | via script | ConfigMap / image layer | T1 | 3-step upload: manifest, bucket uploads, completion token. Deduplicated by hash. |
| Smart Placement | GA | `placement` in script settings; `A/workers/placement/regions` | ✓ | affinity | T1 (field) | Not a separate resource. |
| Observability | GA | `A/workers/observability/*` (destinations, queries, telemetry, issues) | – | logging sidecar | T2 / RO | Tails are sessions, not state. |
| Workers Builds | GA (unverified) | `A/builds/*` (triggers, repo connections, deploy hooks, env) | – | Tekton / BuildConfig | T2 | Repo connection requires an interactive GitHub/GitLab app install. |
| Workers for Platforms | GA | `A/workers/dispatch/namespaces/{ns}/scripts/*` | ✓ (namespace) | Namespace + tenant Deployments | T1 | Outbound workers are configured through the dispatch binding. Use tags to select tenants in bulk. |
| Pages | Maintained (docs: start new projects on Workers) | `A/pages/projects/*` | ✓ | Deployment | T2 | Uploads need a JWT. Behind Workers on features. Workers Sites is the deprecated one. |
| Durable Objects | GA (SQLite) | `A/workers/durable_objects/namespaces` (**read-only**) | via script | StatefulSet | T1 (via Worker) | Namespaces exist **only through Worker-upload migrations**. New ones must be SQLite (since 2026-07-09). Deleting a class destroys its data. |
| Containers | **GA (2026-04-13)** | `A/containers/applications` (+instances, rollouts, versions), `/registries`, `/image-preparations` | **–** | Deployment / StatefulSet | T1 | amd64 only. There are 6 instance types plus custom ones (up to 4 vCPU / 12 GiB / 20 GB), and no GPUs. `wrangler deploy` isn't transactional across the Worker and the container. |
| Sandbox SDK | GA (2026-04) | none (library on Containers + DO) | – | ephemeral Pod | – | Provision the underlying Container app. The WebSocket transport is deprecated. |
| Dynamic Workers | Open beta (2026-03-24) | none (`worker_loader` binding) | – | ephemeral Pod | – | Nothing to reconcile. Billed per unique worker per day after beta. |
| Workflows | GA | `A/workflows/{name}` (+instances, batch, events, versions) | ✓ | Job / CronJob | T1 | Code lives in a Worker. Declared through `exports` (2026-09). Default retention on Paid is 7 days. |
| Agents SDK / Agent Lee | SDK v0.x / dashboard copilot | none | – | StatefulSet (via DO) / none | – | Frameworks and UI, not resources. |
| Browser Run (ex-Browser Rendering) | GA (renamed 2026-04-15) | `A/browser-rendering/*` | – | Job | T3 | Mostly imperative. Limit is 120 concurrent browsers. |
| Workers VPC | Beta | `A/connectivity/directory/services` | ✓ | Service ExternalName | T1 | Depends on a Tunnel, Mesh or WAN. Needs the "Connectivity Directory" permission. |
| Snippets | GA | `Z/snippets` (+`snippet_rules`) | ✓ | – | T2 | `snippet_rules` is a single list replaced on every PUT. |
| Zaraz | GA | `Z/settings/zaraz/*` | ✓ | ConfigMap | T2 | Changes need a separate publish step. |
| Flagship | Public beta (2026-05-26) | `A/flagship/apps` (+flags) | ✓ | ConfigMap | T2 | |
| Cloudflare for Platforms | GA | WfP + Custom Hostnames (see TLS) | ✓ | – | T1 | Umbrella product: Workers for Platforms plus Cloudflare for SaaS. |
| Constellation | **Removed** | – | – | – | – | Replaced by Workers AI. |

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R2 buckets | GA | `A/r2/buckets` (cors, lifecycle, lock, domains/custom, domains/managed, sippy, local-uploads, jobs) | ✓ | PVC / `r2_buckets` | T1 | Name must be unique within the account and jurisdiction. Jurisdiction (eu, us, fedramp) and location hint are immutable. Delete fails if the bucket isn't empty. |
| R2 S3 credentials | GA | derived from an R2-scoped API token; `A/r2/temp-access-credentials` | – | Secret | T1 | access key = token ID; secret = SHA-256(token value). Available only when the token is created. |
| R2 event notifications | GA | `A/event_notifications/r2/{bucket}/configuration/queues/{q}` | ✓ | – | T1 | The Queue must exist first. |
| R2 Infrequent Access | GA | bucket `storage_class` + lifecycle transitions | ✓ | StorageClass | T1 (field) | 30-day minimum, plus retrieval fees. |
| R2 Local Uploads | Open beta (2026-02) | `A/r2/buckets/{b}/local-uploads` | – | – | T2 | |
| R2 Data Catalog (Iceberg) | Beta, billed since 2026-08-03 | `A/basin-catalog/{bucket}` (the `A/r2-catalog` path is deprecated) | ✓ | – | T2 | Tables are created through the Iceberg REST endpoint. Maintenance needs a stored token. |
| R2 SQL | Open beta, billed | none (query engine) | – | – | – | Nothing to provision. |
| Super Slurper | GA | `A/slurper/jobs` | – | Job | T3 | One-shot migrations. |
| Sippy | GA | `A/r2/buckets/{b}/sippy` | ✓ | – | T2 | Source credentials are write-only. |
| D1 | GA | `A/d1/database` (query, import, export, time_travel) | ✓ | PVC / `d1_databases` | T1 | Jurisdiction is set at creation. Deleting destroys data. Read replicas only help if the Worker uses the Sessions API. Schema migrations run as a Job. |
| Workers KV | GA | `A/storage/kv/namespaces` | ✓ | ConfigMap / `kv_namespaces` | T1 | **The legacy `A/workers/namespaces/*` routes stop working on 2026-10-15.** Eventually consistent. Title must be unique. |
| Queues | GA (Free plan since 2026-02) | `A/queues` (+consumers, messages, metrics) | ✓ | – / `queues` | T1 | Only one Worker consumer per queue. The DLQ must already exist. Purge is destructive. |
| Event subscriptions | GA (2025-08) | `A/event_subscriptions/subscriptions` | – | – | T2 | Platform events delivered to a Queue. |
| Pipelines | Open beta, billed | `A/pipelines/v1/{streams,sinks,pipelines}` | ✓ | – / `pipelines` | T2 | Sinks and pipelines can't be updated, so changes mean delete and recreate. |
| Hyperdrive | GA (MySQL GA 2026-08) | `A/hyperdrive/configs` | ✓ | ExternalName + Secret / `hyperdrive` | T1 | The origin password is write-only and must be resent on every update. Can reach private databases through Workers VPC. |
| PlanetScale via Cloudflare | New (2026-06) | dashboard / partner CLI; consumed through Hyperdrive | – | external DB | – | CF holds only the Hyperdrive config. |
| Vectorize | GA | `A/vectorize/v2/indexes` (v1 is deprecated) | **–** | PVC / `vectorize` | T2 | Dimensions and metric are immutable. Metadata indexes must exist before you insert. |
| Analytics Engine | GA | `A/analytics_engine/sql` | – | – / `analytics_engine_datasets` | RO | Datasets are created implicitly on first write. |
| Secrets Store | Open beta | `A/secrets_store/stores` (+secrets) | ✓ | Secret / `secrets_store_secrets` | T1 | Beta allows 1 store and 100 secrets. Values can't be read back. |
| Durable Objects storage | GA | see DO | – | StatefulSet PVC | T1 (via Worker) | Jurisdictions: eu, us, fedramp. |
| Artifacts | Private/closed beta (2026-04) | `A/artifacts/namespaces` (+repos, tokens) | – | PVC (git FS) | T2 | Namespace jurisdiction is immutable. Tokens are shown only once. |
| Agent Memory | Private beta | `A/agent-memory/namespaces` | – | PVC | T2 | No update verb. Deletes are asynchronous. |
| Cache Reserve | GA | `Z/cache/cache_reserve` | ✓ | – | T2 | Must be cleared before it can be disabled. |

### 3.8 Tunnel, private networking, Mesh

| Product | Status | API | TF | K8s analogy | Tier | Gotcha |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cloudflare Tunnel (remotely managed) | GA | `A/cfd_tunnel` (+configurations, connections, token) | ✓ | Ingress / Gateway controller | T1 | The ingress config is replace-all. The token is a secret. The `connections` field is **removed 2026-10-05**; use `/connections`. The operator also runs `cloudflared` as a Deployment. |
| Private routes / virtual networks | GA | `A/teamnet/{routes,virtual_networks}`, `A/zerotrust/{routes/hostname,subnets}` | ✓ | – | T1 | The CIDR-encoded route endpoints are **removed 2026-10-05**. Store `route_id`. |

## 4. Proposed CRD set

**Scope, clarified 2026-09-29:** flare-operator is a **Kubernetes-native interface to all Cloudflare resources and settings**, in the same spirit as AWS ACK or GCP Config Connector. There is one CRD per Cloudflare resource, and its fields mirror the API. CRDs are generated from the OpenAPI spec using its `x-fern-sdk-group-name` / `x-fern-sdk-method-name` annotations:

- about 338 groups have both create and delete, so they map to ordinary resources
- about 154 groups have get plus update/edit but no create, so they map to singleton settings

The hand-written list below becomes the set of **overrides**: resources whose API shape doesn't fit generic CRUD, such as Worker multipart upload, Containers with image push, the Tunnel with its `cloudflared` connector, replace-all lists, and credential outputs. Using Cloudflare as a runtime (the Mode A workflows, e.g. Worker → Hyperdrive/VPC service → Tunnel → cluster Service) is a use case built on these CRDs, not the core design.

**v0 (Tier 1 core, API group `flare.dev/v1alpha1`):**

- **Private connectivity:** `Tunnel` (remotely managed, `config_src: cloudflare`; token stored in a Secret; `cloudflared` run as a Deployment) and `VPCService` (`A/connectivity/directory/services`, Workers VPC beta).

- **Credentials and zones:** `CloudflareAccount` (cluster-scoped: account ID + token Secret, rate limiter, default tags) and `Zone` (adopt only).
- **Compute:** `Worker` (script + versions + deployment + routes, custom domains, crons, bindings by reference) and `ContainerApp` (scheduler or DO mode, rollouts, registry creds).
- **Storage:** `R2Bucket` (+ notifications, S3-credential Secret output), `D1Database` (+ `D1Migration` Job-style), `KVNamespace`, `Queue` (+ consumer), `Hyperdrive`, `SecretStoreSecret`.
- **DNS:** `DNSRecord`.

**v1:**

- **Workflows:** `Workflow`.
- **Tunnel and private networking:** `Tunnel` (+ a managed `cloudflared` Deployment + ingress config), `TunnelRoute`, `VirtualNetwork`, `VPCService`.
- **Access:** `AccessApplication`, `AccessPolicy`, `AccessServiceToken`.
- **Traffic:** `LoadBalancer` / `LBPool` / `LBMonitor`, `CustomHostname`, `ZoneRuleset` (per phase).
- **Gateway API:** `cloudflare-tunnel` and `cloudflare-workers` GatewayClass controllers (HTTPRoute, with TCPRoute through Spectrum later).

**v2:**

- **Adapters:** `Deployment` → `ContainerApp`, `CronJob` → cron trigger, `Service` → binding / VPC service.
- **Generated long tail:** Tier 2 CRDs generated from OpenAPI with a Forge plugin, driven by `hack/classify_api.py` tiers.
- **Job-style CRDs for Tier 3:** `CachePurge`, `SlurperJob`, `RegistrarDomain` (behind a feature gate).

**Terraform has no resource** for Containers, Vectorize, Workers Builds, Observability, Artifacts or Agent Memory. For those, a CRD operator is the only declarative option today.

## 5. Scheduled changes that affect the operator

| Date | Change |
|---|---|
| 2026-09-30 | Service Key (`X-Auth-User-Service-Key`) reaches end of life. |
| 2026-10-05 | Tunnel CIDR-encoded route endpoints removed; `connections` field removed from tunnel list/get. |
| 2026-10-15 | Legacy KV `A/workers/namespaces/*` routes stop working. |
| 2026-11-23 | `foundation_dns` boolean reaches end of life. |
| 2027-03-31 | Batch `Z/settings` GET/PATCH reaches end of life. |
| Already in effect | New DO namespaces must be SQLite (2026-07-09). DNS record type changes via update ended (2026-06-30). `A/roles` deprecated. Legacy registrar endpoints reached end of life (2026-09-27). `A/r2-catalog`, flat `A/ai-search/instances`, legacy `A/pipelines` and Vectorize v1 are deprecated. |
